title: Retreat and Rest Balance
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=retreat:event type=retreat
| stats max(_time) as last_retreat
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_retreat)/86400,1)
description: Tracks how long it has been since your last retreat or dedicated day of rest and reflection.
value: Rhythms of rest are easy to neglect; a simple counter prompts you to plan the next one.
implementation: Ingest retreat events into `index=personal`; count days since the last one.
visualization: Single-value panel of days since last retreat.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It counts how long since you last took a proper day of rest and reflection, nudging you to plan the next.
